name: Hospital de Sant Pau
scope: Operations and Our Lady of Mount Carmel pavilions of the restored Hospital de Sant Pau in Barcelona, shown as one geographic asset. Other campus buildings and the underground galleries are outside this model scope.

references.filename: Pavelló d'Operacions, Hospital de Sant Pau, Barcelona, Spain.jpg

originalReview.notes: The restored Operations Pavilion has a tiled gable with a sculpted crest, blue ceramics, a two-level arcaded projection and green-trimmed windows.

references.filename: Pavelló de Nostra Senyora del Carme, Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau, Barcelona, 2015.jpg

originalReview.notes: The restored Carme Pavilion has a glazed, domed southern rotunda, a carved stone entrance portal and a taller open-sided ceramic water tower to its north.

review.method: Two byte-identical Qualla CC0 native originals
review.notes: Inspected both exact public-domain Qualla photos. Images with attribution/share-alike licenses and the rest of the campus were excluded. No supplemental image was needed for these photographed pavilions.
